en: Illustrated wartime scene showing Bulgarian infantry in green uniforms with bayonets charging uphill under a red military flag bearing a small yellow emblem. Smoke and gunfire fill the background, with a hilltop fortification or earthworks visible above. Fallen soldiers in blue uniforms lie on the ground in the foreground. The caption in Bulgarian Cyrillic appears at the top, and a small printer/artist credit is at the bottom.
